# openinfra_query (Resource)

A one-shot SQL query over object storage — the Athena-shaped primitive. Results are written to a bucket as CSV.

Note this is a **job, not a desired state**: changing `sql` runs a new query rather than altering the old one, so the field forces replacement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `sql` (String) The SQL to run. duckdb reads with `read_parquet('s3://…')`; trino uses catalog tables.

### Optional

- `engine` (String) `duckdb` for serverless single-node schema-on-read, or `trino` for the federating warehouse engine.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `output_bucket` (String) MinIO bucket for the CSV result and its `<id>.metadata.json`. Created if absent.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `phase` (String)
- `query_id` (String)
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
- `result_location` (String) `s3://` URI of the result object.
